name: Wien-Ticket
notes: category listing pages (/de/{konzerte,klassik,kultur,musicals-shows,sport,freizeit}/catalog, paginated /catalog/fromN) embed a base64 GA4 data-tracking blob per <li> with clean date/venue/price/category fields, no per-detail-page fetches needed; some items (city-pass style standing tickets, e.g. hop-on-hop-off bus, museum day tickets) carry a stale placeholder veranstaltungsdatum in the past — detected via start<today and emitted as extra.permanent=true with start=today, end=null instead of trusting the bogus date
